text: dsh-wigolo 为 DSH Web 客户端接入自托管 Wigolo 联网服务，通过配置面板连接 daemon，并可选择接管内置 web_search 与 web_fetch。插件还注册搜索、爬取、结构化提取、研究、相似内容、本地缓存和 URL 监控等 agent 工具；侧栏提供连接配置、工具开关与缓存浏览。适合需要在 DSH 中进行可配置联网检索、批量抓取资料或查看缓存内容的用户。需要一个可访问的 Wigolo daemon 和对应 token；默认连接本机 127.0.0.1:3333，接管默认关闭。

dsh-wigolo connects DSH to a self-hosted Wigolo daemon. Its sidebar configures the connection and optional web search/fetch takeover. Agent tools search, crawl, extract data, research, and manage cached pages and URL monitoring. Requires a reachable daemon and token.

有没有办法在 DSH 里查看以前抓过的网页缓存

Can I crawl documentation pages and reuse the saved results later?

Help me research a topic with parallel searches and cited findings.
dsh-wigolo 的功能「联网搜索」：agent 可用 wigolo_search 按类别、时间、域名或搜索深度查询；打开接管后，DSH 的 web_search 与 web_fetch 也转给 Wigolo。
dsh-wigolo 的功能「爬取与结构化提取」：wigolo_crawl 从种子网址按深度、页数和匹配规则遍历页面；wigolo_extract 则按 CSS 选择器或字段 schema 提取页面内容。
dsh-wigolo 的功能「缓存与监控」：agent 工具可搜索或管理本地缓存，并创建和查看 URL 变化监控；启用缓存标签页后，用户还能在会话界面筛选缓存条目并预览或复制 Markdown。

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · dsh-wigolo：[中文文档](./README.zh.md)

**Self-hosted web search for [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) (DeepSeek Harness).** This plugin integrates a privately deployed [wigolo](https://github.com/KnockOutEZ/wigolo) meta-search daemon into DSH, replacing the built-in web search with your own self-hosted search infrastructure — full control over search engines, caching, and data privacy.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · dsh-wigolo：> **Core purpose:** Proxy and replace DSH's built-in `web_search` / `web_fetch` with a self-hosted wigolo daemon. One toggle switches all agent web searches to your private deployment — no cloud dependencies, no API keys, zero cost per query.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · dsh-wigolo：```
dsh web GUI ── sidebar panel ── /api/dsh-wigolo/* ──┐
                                                     │
agent tools (wigolo_search, …) ── MCP streamable-http ──► wigolo daemon
web seam (web_search / web_fetch) ───────────────────┘   18+ engines · RRF · local cache

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Features：- **Agent-first design** — seven tools (`wigolo_search`, `wigolo_crawl`, `wigolo_extract`, `wigolo_research`, `wigolo_find_similar`, `wigolo_cache`, `wigolo_watch`) expose trimmed, model-friendly parameter surfaces. Write operations stay agent-only; read-only cache/watch browsing also lives in an opt-in **"Wigolo Cache"** conversation tab (off by default).
- **Provider takeover, configurable** — route the official `web_search` / `web_fetch` through wigolo with one switch (on = wigolo drives both, off = official providers), toggled from the GUI with automatic cordis routing management.
- **Official settings integration** — `enabled`, `announceToAgent`, and `guidance` override live in the official DSH settings UI (dsh-ssh pattern). Hot-reload: change settings, no restart needed.
- **Sidebar panel** (React, i18n) — four tabs: Connection (live test + latency), Takeover & Tools, About, and Help (bundled usage guide rendered in-panel). Connection settings with live test + latency, takeover switch, tool exposure flags, and the cache-tab toggle, all loopback-fenced. Token can be written directly from the panel (no terminal required).

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Prerequisites：A running [wigolo daemon](https://knockoutez.github.io/wigolo/docs/) (v0.2+), reachable over HTTP with a bearer token. Local (`127.0.0.1:3333`) is the default and needs zero extra setup.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · From GitHub：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo
```

Both methods install the plugin and automatically register it in the profile's bundle list (via the plugin's bundled `cordis.patch.yml`). No manual editing required.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Local development (link mode)：```bash
git clone https://github.com/tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo.git
cd dsh-wigolo
pnpm install
pnpm build

This clones the repo, builds it, and registers the plugin in the profile's bundle list automatically via `link:` (no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing needed).

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Post-install：Put your daemon token into `~/.dsh/wigolo-token` (first line, 0600):

```bash
echo "YOUR_TOKEN" > ~/.dsh/wigolo-token && chmod 600 ~/.dsh/wigolo-token
```

Restart dsh, open the **Wigolo** entry in the sidebar, and hit **Test connection**.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo
```

This removes the plugin and its bundle registration. The token file `~/.dsh/wigolo-token` and config `~/.dsh/wigolo.json` are preserved (delete manually if desired).

For detailed usage scenarios and examples, see the [Usage Guide (中文)](./GUIDE.zh.md).

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Via GUI (recommended)：All settings can be configured through the **Wigolo sidebar panel** (click the Wigolo icon in the sidebar):

- **Connection tab**: Host, port, token, hostHeader, test connection
- **Takeover & Tools tab**: Takeover switch, tool enable/disable, cache tab toggle
- **About tab**: Version info, documentation links

Changes take effect immediately (hot-reload), except for the takeover switch which requires a restart.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Takeover switch：`takeover` is a simple boolean:

| Value | `web_search` | `web_fetch` | Notes |
|------|--------------|--------------|-------|
| `true` | wigolo | wigolo | full replacement |
| `false` | official | official | wigolo_* tools only (default) |

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Takeover switch：Why a switch at all: when several providers register into the web seam and none is explicitly routed, `web_search` fails with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`. Takeover on (`true`) therefore also writes a self-managed block into `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (`searchProvider: wigolo`, dsh-skin-style managed markers); takeover off (`false`) removes it and registers nothing, so it coexists safely with the official provider. Routing changes need a dsh **restart** — the panel tells you when.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Timezone：The wigolo daemon persists cache timestamps as zone-less UTC (`"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`). The plugin converts them to the configured timezone before returning to the agent or rendering in the UI.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Timezone：| Value | Example | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `"local"` | `"local"` | Use the DSH host's system timezone (default) |
| Numeric offset | `"+8"`, `"-5"`, `"+5.5"` | Fixed offset from UTC; supports half-hour zones |
| IANA name | `"Asia/Shanghai"`, `"America/New_York"` | Full timezone with DST rules |

Changes to `timezone` take effect after a dsh restart.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · The Host header, explained：`hostHeader: "auto"` (default) sends **no** custom header for local daemons and the bind-host trick for remote ones. Set a literal only if your deployment needs it.

@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Agent tools：| Tool | Wigolo capability | Highlights | Timeout |
|------|-------------------|-----------|---------|
| `wigolo_search` | search | category / time_range / domain filters / depth tiers / `"a \| b"` multi-variant queries | 60s |
| `wigolo_crawl` | crawl | site crawl with patterns, strategy, page caps; every page lands in the cache | 300s |
| `wigolo_extract` | extract | CSS selector or field-schema structured extraction | 60s |
| `wigolo_research` | research | decomposes, searches in parallel, synthesizes a cited report | 600s |
| `wigolo_find_similar` | find_similar | related content from URL or concept (default off) | 120s |
| `wigolo_cache` | cache | search the local cache **before** hitting the network; stats / clear | 30s |
| `wigolo_watch` | watch | persistent URL change monitoring; pair with a scheduled agent task for notifications | 120s |
@tianjiqx/dsh-wigolo README · Agent tools：All timeouts are configurable per tool via `timeoutMs` in the config.
